compute_binary_classification_metrics: compute binary classification metrics like f1, precision, recall, auc, and accuracy from raw predictions and labels
compute_multi_class_classification_metri: compute multi-class classification metrics with macro, micro, and weighted averaging for f1, precision, and recall
process_image_classification_data: process training and validation image data with albumentations transforms including random crop, rotation, and normalization
create_model_card: create a model card with validation metrics, dataset tags, and base model info for an image classification model
review_EVAL_METRICS_tuples: review the BINARY_CLASSIFICATION_EVAL_METRICS and MULTI_CLASS_CLASSIFICATION_EVAL_METRICS tuples to understand which eval keys are tracked
